_about: Hand annotations for the five-scene understanding pilot (tests/test_understanding.py). The L2 tests run P2a/P2b offline against these expectations: the FilmBrief's load-bearing beats, sequence map and set-piece candidates, and every scene's load_bearing / set_piece / sequence_id after apply_film_flags. The scene responder reports load_bearing=false and no sequence_id on purpose — the pipeline must derive both from the brief (and from temperature ≥ 8).

load_bearing_beats.name: inciting
load_bearing_beats.note: Ravi does not come to the jetty; Anju takes the witness herself

load_bearing_beats.name: midpoint
load_bearing_beats.note: the checkpoint: Anju chooses the witness over her brother's alibi

load_bearing_beats.name: climax
load_bearing_beats.note: Ammachi returns the locket; loyalty is paid, not passed on

the price is paid at home
